chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) in urging his companions to fight
ai.seo_question: What is the context of Imam Ali's exhortation to his companions to fight?
ai.summary: This heading introduces Imam Ali’s (AS) decisive address to his companions, urging them to pursue the Battle of the Camel to enforce justice and quell the rebellion of Aisha, Talha, and Zubayr. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on his legitimate authority and the necessity of armed resistance against those who deviated from the Quran and Sunnah after the Prophet’s death.
